[Data utilities] Validates a JSON document against a JSON Schema (draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12, formats included) and returns valid true/false with every error as a JSON Pointer, keyword and message. Input: json and schema (POST for large documents). Limits: 1 MB JSON, 200 KB schema, 100 errors listed; remote $ref is not fetched. Offline.

json.description: JSON text, up to 1 MB (a JSON value is also accepted in a POST body or MCP arguments)

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12) as JSON text or object, up to 200 KB
